criteria.criterion: Run folders are ordered by the earliest timestamp of their records (iteration and session records), falling back to the name only for a folder with no timestamped record; existing folders are not renamed.

criteria.criterion: Every consumer that depends on folder order (metrics, the missing-records list, defect derivation, gate-failure/commit pairing, close) sees the timestamp order.
criteria.evidence: sorting is in runs.Load; metrics, defects, close and cli/defect all consume m.Folders

criteria.criterion: Tests cover a UTC folder name under a non-UTC zone and two folders whose names sort opposite to their records (a DST fall-back); the checks run them.

criteria.evidence: diff touches only newRunDir and adds ordering helpers; no B12 refactor
